column1: # dkmovie.x's player functions a port replaces (include/platform/movie.h): the front end reaches the
# player only through these entries of its table D_00F28478 (ovl/dkmovie/relocs.tsv), so a port
# points them at its own player and links only the functions the front end reaches
# (tools/host/ovlnative.py). The player's ~116 functions (IPU decoder, MMI colour conversion, SPU
# audio over SIF DMA) are PS2-only.
